articles.title: Natural history and clinical impact of epilepsy in adults with Down syndrome: a multicentre clinical study
articles.authors: Maure-Blesa L, Carmona-Iragui M, Barroeta I, Arranz J, Fernández S, Rodríguez-Baz Í, Benejam B, Videla L, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: As individuals with Down syndrome age, they face high risks of Alzheimer's disease and epilepsy. With symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, late-onset myoclonic epilepsy in Down syndrome (LOMEDS) often emerges. We aimed to examine how epilepsy develops in Down syndrome, its timing relative to Alzheimer's disease symptom onset, and its effect on prognosis.
abstract.textZh: 作為唐氏綜合徵年齡的個體，他們面臨阿茲海默症和癲癇的高風險。伴隨症狀性阿茲海默症，唐氏綜合症（ LOMEDS ）中晚發性肌陣攣性癲癇（ LOMEDS ）經常出現。我們的目的是檢查唐氏綜合症中癲癇的發展、與阿茲海默症症狀發作相關的時機及其對預後的影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a multicentre, observational, longitudinal study across seven international cohorts with an aggregate observation window from Oct 24, 2012, to July 28, 2025. We included adults with Down syndrome aged at least 18 years and with at least one longitudinal clinical assessment. Alzheimer's disease staging was done by clinical consensus. Active epilepsy required an epilepsy diagnosis plus ongoing antiseizure medication or at least one seizure within the past 5 years. We analysed active epilepsy prevalence, incidence and cumulative incidence, its timing with respect to symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, and its effect on survival and cognitive trajectories as well as electroencephalogram (EEG) abnormalities.
abstract.textZh: 我們在2012年10月24日至2025年7月28日期間，對七個國際隊列進行了多中心、觀察性、縱向研究，並進行了綜合觀察窗口。我們納入了年齡至少為18歲且至少有一次縱向臨牀評估的唐氏綜合症成人。阿茲海默症分期依臨牀共識進行。活動性癲癇需要在過去5年內進行癲癇診斷，加上持續的抗癲癇藥物治療，或至少一次癲癇發作。我們分析了活動性癲癇的患病率，發病率和累積發病率，其與症狀性阿茲海默症相關的時間，及其對生存和認知軌跡以及腦電圖（ EEG ）異常的影響。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: We included 4804 adults with Down syndrome (mean age 43 years [SD 13]): 3238 (67·4%) were cognitively stable, 267 (5·6%) had non-degenerative cognitive decline, 321 (6·7%) had prodromal Alzheimer's disease, and 978 (20·3%) had Alzheimer's disease dementia. Intellectual disability was mild in 1020 (24·6%) participants, moderate in 2352 (56·7%), and severe to profound in 779 (18·8%). Active epilepsy prevalence was 145·2 per adults with Down syndrome overall but significantly increased with age, particularly with symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, when epilepsy manifested mostly as myoclonic or tonic-clonic seizures. Cumulative incidence of epilepsy increased linearly after symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, from 9·5% (95% CI 7·8-11·3) at diagnosis to 56·9% (51·7-61·7) after 9 years. Risk of epilepsy increased with time since Alzheimer's disease diagnosis (adjusted odds ratio 1·33 per year [95% CI 1·22-1·45]; p<0·0001), severe-to-profound intellectual disability (2·14 per year [1·25-3·70]; p=0·0057), and APOE ε4 carriership (1·61 per year [1·04-2·49]; p=0·034), independent of age. LOMEDS was associated with increased mortality (hazard ratio 2·10 [95% CI 1·57-2·82]; p<0·0001), and faster cognitive decline. Interictal EEG abnormalities showed little diagnostic utility.
abstract.textZh: 我們納入了4804名患有唐氏綜合症的成年人（平均年齡43歲[SD 13] ） ： 3238 （ 67.4 ％ ）認知穩定， 267 （ 5.6 ％ ）有非退行性認知衰退， 321 （ 6.7 ％ ）有前驅性阿茲海默症， 978 （ 20.3 ％ ）有阿茲海默症失智症。 智力障礙在1020名參與者中為輕度（ 24.6 ％ ） ，在2352名參與者中為中度（ 56.7 ％ ） ，在779名參與者中為重度至重度（ 18.8 ％ ）。 整體而言，每位唐氏綜合症成人的活動性癲癇患病率為145.2 ，但隨著年齡的增長而顯著增加，特別是有症狀的阿茲海默症，當時癲癇主要表現為肌陣攣或強直性陣攣性癲癇發作。 癲癇的累積發病率在症狀性阿茲海默症後線性增加，從診斷時的9.5 ％ （ 95 ％ CI 7.8-11.3 ）到9年後的56.9 ％ （ 51.7-61.7 ）。 自阿茲海默症診斷以來，癲癇的風險隨著時間的推移而增加（調整比率為每年1 · 33 [95 ％ CI 1 · 22-1 · 45]; p < 0.0001 ） ，嚴重至顯著的智力障礙（每年2 · 14 [1 · 25-3 · 70]; p = 0 · 0057 ）和APOE ε4攜帶者（每年1 · 61 [1 · 04-2 · 49]; p = 0 · 034 ） ，與年齡無關。 LOMEDS與死亡率增加有關（風險比2 · 10 [95% CI 1 · 57-2 · 82] ； p < 0 · 0001 ） ，認知能力下降更快。 發作期間的腦電圖異常顯示幾乎沒有診斷效用。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Epilepsy increases sharply after symptomatic Alzheimer's disease onset in people with Down syndrome. The association of epilepsy with reduced survival and accelerated cognitive decline underscores the need for targeted preventive and therapeutic strategies against Alzheimer's disease-related epileptogenesis and hyperexcitability.
abstract.textZh: 唐氏綜合症患者出現症狀性阿茲海默症後，癲癇會急劇增加。癲癇與存活率降低和加速認知衰退的關聯強調了針對阿茲海默症相關癲癇發生和過度興奮性的針對性預防和治療策略的必要性。

articles.title: Targeted left ventricular lead placement in biventricular pacing for heart failure: a national, multicentre, double-blind, randomised controlled trial in Denmark
articles.authors: Nielsen JC, Svendsen JH, Johansen JB, Larsen JM, Larroudé CE, Poulsen SH, Eiskjær H, Nørgaard BL, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Left ventricular lead position is a key determinant of optimal biventricular pacing for heart failure. Observational data indicate better outcomes in patients with late myocardial activation at the left ventricular lead site. We aimed to test whether targeting the left ventricular lead at site of latest electrical activation improves outcomes.
abstract.textZh: 左心室導程位置是心力衰竭最佳雙心室心律調節的關鍵決定因素。觀察數據表明，左心室導聯部位心肌激活較晚的患者預後較好。我們的目的是測試在最近的電激活部位瞄準左心室導聯是否能改善結果。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this national, randomised, controlled, double-blinded, superiority trial we included patients from all five Danish university centres performing device implantation who had heart failure and wide QRS on guideline-directed medication, eligible for biventricular pacing. We randomly assigned (1:1) patients to either the intervention group, with left ventricular lead placement at the latest electrically activated site within the coronary sinus branches, or to control group, with left ventricular lead placement in a posterolateral non-apical branch. Primary outcome was a composite of time to death or first unplanned heart failure hospitalisation. We used block randomisation and masked patients and all study personnel (except operating room personnel) to treatment allocation. The primary outcome was a composite of time to death or first unplanned hospitalisation for heart failure. Analysis followed a modified intention-to-treat approach. Safety was assessed in all correctly assigned patients. The trial is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03280862) and is complete.
abstract.textZh: 在這項全國性、隨機、對照、雙盲、優越性試驗中，我們包括來自所有五個丹麥大學中心進行裝置植入的患者，這些患者患有心力衰竭和針對指南用藥的廣泛QRS ，符合雙心室起搏的資格。 我們將患者隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ）到幹預組，將左心室導線放置在冠狀竇分支中最新的電激活部位，或將患者隨機分配到對照組，將左心室導線放置在後外側非心尖分支。 主要結果是死亡時間或首次計劃外心力衰竭住院的綜合結果。 我們使用區塊隨機分組和遮罩患者和所有研究人員（手術室人員除外）進行治療分配。 主要結果是心力衰竭的死亡時間或首次計劃外住院的綜合結果。 分析遵循改良的意向治療方法。 在所有正確分配的患者中評估安全性。 試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03280862)註冊並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From March 20, 2018, to June 3, 2024, we included 1001 patients (255 females and 746 males); 499 were randomly assigned to the intervention group and 502 to the control group. One incorrectly enrolled patient was excluded, leaving 1000 patients for the modified intention-to-treat analysis. Electrical activation at left ventricular lead was a mean of 9 milliseconds (95% CI 5-13) later in the intervention group. Follow-up was completed on Feb 27, 2026, after a median 45·8 months (IQR 28·5-65·7). The primary endpoint occurred in 139 (28%) of 499 patients in the intervention group and 128 (26%) of 501 in control group (hazard ratio 1·10 [95% CI 0·86-1·39]; p=0·45). Overall complication risk was similar between groups (71 [14%] patients in the intervention group vs 64 [13%] in the control group), but lead-related complications were more frequent in the intervention group. One procedure-related death occurred in the intervention group.
abstract.textZh: 從2018年3月20日至2024年6月3日，我們納入了1001名患者（ 255名女性和746名男性） ； 499名患者被隨機分配到幹預組， 502名患者被隨機分配到對照組。排除了一名不正確入組的患者，留下1000名患者進行修改的意向治療分析。介入組在9毫秒(95% CI 5-13)後，左心室導線處的電激活為平均值。中位數45 · 8個月(IQR 28 · 5-65 · 7)後，於2026年2月27日完成追蹤。主要終點發生在介入組499名患者中的139名（ 28% ）和對照組501名患者中的128名（ 26% ） （風險比1 · 10 [95% CI 0 · 86-1 · 39] ； p = 0 · 45 ）。整體併發症風險在各組之間相似（介入組71 [14%]名患者與對照組64 [13%]名患者） ，但介入組中與鉛相關的併發症更為頻繁。介入組中發生了一例與手術相關的死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In patients with heart failure and prolonged QRS, targeted left ventricular lead placement at the site of latest electrical activation did not reduce the composite endpoint of death or unplanned hospitalisation for heart failure compared with conventional lead placement in a posterolateral, non-apical position.

articles.title: Aetiology, management, and outcomes of acute heart failure in 17 African countries (THESUS-HF II): a prospective, multicentre, observational cohort study
articles.authors: Sliwa K, Hahnle J, Stewart S, Allie S, Damasceno A, Smit D, Jessen N, Sani MU, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Contemporary data on the aetiology, management, and outcomes of acute heart failure across Africa are scarce. We aimed to conduct a contemporary assessment of acute heart failure aetiology, treatment patterns, presentation rates, and 180-day outcomes across Africa.
abstract.textZh: 關於整個非洲急性心力衰竭的病因學、管理和結果的當代數據很少。我們的目標是對整個非洲的急性心力衰竭病因、治療模式、呈現率和180天的結果進行當代評估。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: THESUS-HF II was a prospective, multicentre, observational cohort study in 50 hospitals across 17 African countries. Adults aged 18 years or older with acute heart failure were enrolled during seven 24 h surveillance periods within an 8-week, site-specific window. Acute heart failure was identified by acute dyspnoea and congestion, supported by electrocardiography, chest radiography, and point-of-care echocardiography. We assessed presentation rates per 10 000 people in the adult catchment population per week, treatment patterns (including medication use at discharge), readmission, and all-cause mortality through to 180 days. This study was registered with the Pan African Clinical Trial Registry (PACTR202410553810557) and is completed; however, substudies are ongoing.
abstract.textZh: THESUS-HF II是一項前瞻性、多中心、觀察性隊列研究，在17個非洲國家的50家醫院進行。18歲或以上患有急性心力衰竭的成年人在8週的特定研究中心窗口內的7個24小時監測期間入組。急性心力衰竭由急性呼吸困難和充血確定，並得到心電圖、胸片和即時心臟超音波檢查的支持。我們評估了每週成人流域人口中每萬人的呈現率、治療模式（包括出院時的藥物使用）、再入院率以及至180天的全因死亡率。本研究已在泛非臨牀試驗註冊處（ PACTR202410553810557 ）註冊並已完成；然而，子研究仍在進行中。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between July 1, 2024, and July 31, 2025, 1741 patients were assessed for eligibility at participating hospitals and 1578 were included in the study cohort. 793 (50·5%) of 1570 participants were female, 777 (49·5%) were male, and 1533 (97·8%) of 1567 were of African descent; median age was 56·0 years (IQR 40·0-69·0). The weekly acute heart failure presentation rate was 0·03 per 10 000 people (95% CI 0·02-0·05) overall and 0·02 per 10 000 people (0·01-0·04) for de novo acute heart failure. De novo acute heart failure accounted for 1007 (64·2%) of 1568 presentations. The leading aetiologies were hypertensive heart disease (576 [36·5%] of 1578), cardiomyopathy (370 [23·4%]), and ischaemic heart disease (367 [23·3%]). Median hospital ward stay was 6·0 days (IQR 4·0-10·0), and in-hospital mortality was 8·7% (95% CI 7·3-10·2; 134 of 1542 patients). At discharge, renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system inhibitors were prescribed in 1014 (73·9%) of 1373 patients, β blockers in 1053 (76·9%) of 1369 patients, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists in 982 (71·9%) of 1366, and SGLT2 inhibitors in 743 (54·7%) of 1359; target doses were reached in fewer than half of patients. Of 1567 patients included in time-to-event analyses, 528 (33·7%) were lost to follow-up before 180 days. All-cause mortality was 11·1% (95% CI 9·6-12·9; 160 deaths) at 30 days and 20·6% (18·4-23·0; 255 deaths) at 180 days. All-cause mortality did not differ across aetiological groups over 30 days (log-rank p=0·39), but differed over 180 days (p=0·019).

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Compared with THESUS-HF, THESUS-HF II suggests an evolving aetiological profile of acute heart failure in Africa, although differences in ascertainment and diagnostic capability might have contributed to the apparent aetiological shift. High mortality in this relatively young cohort highlights the importance of heart failure prevention, access to cardiac care, guideline-directed therapy, and post-discharge follow-up. These findings suggest that short-term acute heart failure outcomes are not driven by its demographic, aetiological, and echocardiographic factors.
abstract.textZh: 與THESUS-HF相比， THESUS-HF II表明非洲急性心力衰竭的病因概況不斷發展，儘管確定和診斷能力的差異可能導致了明顯的病因轉變。在這個相對年輕的隊列中，高死亡率突顯了預防心力衰竭、獲得心臟護理、指南導向治療和出院後隨訪的重要性。這些發現表明，短期急性心力衰竭的結果不是由其人口統計學、病因學和超聲心動圖因素驅動的。

articles.title: Radiotherapy versus observation following surgical resection of WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma (ROAM/EORTC-1308): an international, multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Jenkinson MD, Rosala-Hallas A, Sahm F, Andratschke N, Ashkan K, Balestrini D, Bulbeck H, Comas S, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma is a primary brain tumour with a high risk of recurrence even after complete surgical resection. The role of adjuvant radiotherapy remains uncertain. We aimed to assess whether adjuvant radiotherapy reduces recurrence compared with observation in patients with a newly diagnosed atypical meningioma who have undergone complete surgical resection.
abstract.textZh: WHO第2級非典型腦膜瘤是原發性腦腫瘤，即使在完全手術切除後仍有高復發風險。輔助放射治療的作用仍然不確定。我們的目標是評估輔助放射治療與觀察相比，在經過完全手術切除的新診斷的非典型腦膜瘤患者中是否減少復發。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: ROAM/EORTC-1308 was an international, multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial, conducted at 58 hospitals and academic centres in 11 countries. Eligible sites had appropriate multidisciplinary expertise, neurosurgery, and radiotherapy facilities. Patients aged 16 years or older who had undergone a surgeon-assessed complete surgical resection of newly diagnosed atypical meningioma were randomly assigned (1:1) to adjuvant radiotherapy or observation. Randomisation was done using a web-based interface using random variable blocks of sizes two and four, stratified by location (UK or non-UK). Participants assigned to the radiotherapy group received fractionated external-beam intensity-modulated radiotherapy at a total dose of 60 Gy in 30 fractions over 6 weeks. Participants were followed up for a minimum of 4 years. The primary outcome was disease-free survival, defined as time from surgery to MRI-confirmed recurrence or death due to any cause, analysed in all randomly assigned participants in their assigned treatment group. Harms analysis was done in the as-treated population. The trial was registered with ISRCTN, ISRCTN71502099, and has completed.
abstract.textZh: ROAM/EORTC-1308是一項國際、多中心、開放標籤、3期、隨機對照試驗，在11個國家的58家醫院和學術中心進行。 符合資格的研究中心擁有適當的多學科專業知識、神經外科和放射治療設施。 接受外科醫生評估的新診斷非典型腦膜瘤完全手術切除的16歲或以上患者被隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ）接受輔助放射治療或觀察。 隨機分組使用基於網絡的界面，使用大小為2和4的隨機變量塊，按地點（英國或非英國）分層。 分配到放射治療組的參與者在6週內以30次分次接受總劑量為60 Gy的分次外照射強度調節放射治療。 參與者被追蹤至少4年。 主要結果是無病生存期，定義為從手術到MRI確認復發或因任何原因死亡的時間，在其分配的治療組中所有隨機分配的參與者中進行分析。 在接受治療的人羣中進行了危害分析。 試驗已在ISRCTN （ ISRCTN71502099 ）註冊並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between April 28, 2016, and May 21, 2021, 990 patients were assessed for eligibility, 157 of whom were randomly assigned to radiotherapy (n=78) or observation (n=79). Median age was 57·40 years (IQR 49·09-66·93); 84 (54%) participants were female and 73 (46%) were male. At a median follow-up of 64 months (IQR 50-75), meningioma recurrence occurred in 11 (14%) of 78 participants in the radiotherapy group and 24 (30%) of 79 in the observation group. 5-year disease-free survival was 79·9% (95% CI 67·6-87·9) in the radiotherapy group and 64·3% (51·9-74·2) in the observation group (absolute difference 15·6% percentage points [95% CI 0·6-30·5]). Disease-free survival was improved in the radiotherapy group compared with the observation group (hazard ratio 0·51 [95% CI 0·27-0·97]; p=0·0396). Grade 2 or 3 radiation-related serious adverse events occurred in five (8%) of 66 participants in the radiotherapy group, with no treatment-related deaths.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Our findings suggest that adjuvant radiotherapy should be considered in patients with atypical meningioma after complete surgical resection of atypical meningioma when the prevention of recurrence is valued higher than the potential delayed adverse effects of radiotherapy. This practice will benefit patients by reducing meningioma recurrence. Decisions should be based on individual discussion with the patient.
abstract.textZh: 我們的研究結果表明，在手術完全切除非典型腦膜瘤後的非典型腦膜瘤患者中，當預防復發的價值高於放射治療的潛在延遲不良反應時，應考慮輔助放射治療。這種做法將通過減少腦膜瘤復發而使患者受益。決定應基於與患者的個別討論。

articles.title: Clinical Uses of Common Genetic Variants Associated with Common Diseases
articles.authors: Hunter DJ, Inouye M

abstract.text: Twenty-five years after the draft of the human genome sequence, genomics has revolutionized many areas of biology, the diagnosis of familial and early-onset diseases, and the development of targeted therapies, particularly in oncology. Genomic knowledge has had little effect on the diagnosis and treatment of most common adult-onset conditions. Genomewide association studies have revealed that for these conditions, thousands of genetic variants of small effect underpin the polygenic nature of risk. When incorporated into polygenic risk scores, these variants predict risk; however, polygenic risk scores have had little effect in the clinic. In this article, we review the reasons for the slow pace of the diffusion of these methods in clinical practice. With the impending era of relatively inexpensive genome sequencing in mind, we review the ways in which polygenic risk scores, along with the related field of pharmacogenomics, may be useful in clinical practice for the prevention and treatment of common diseases.
abstract.textZh: 在人類基因組序列起草25年後，基因組學徹底改變了生物學、家族性和早發性疾病的診斷以及靶向治療的發展，特別是在腫瘤學。 基因組知識對最常見的成人發病疾病的診斷和治療幾乎沒有影響。 全基因組關聯研究表明，在這些情況下，成千上萬的小效應基因變異支撐了風險的多基因性質。 當納入多基因風險評分時，這些變異預測風險；然而，多基因風險評分在臨牀上幾乎沒有影響。 在本文中，我們將回顧這些方法在臨牀實踐中擴散緩慢的原因。 考慮到即將到來的相對便宜的基因組測序時代，我們回顧了多基因風險評分以及相關的藥物基因組學領域在預防和治療常見疾病的臨牀實踐中可能有用的方法。

articles.title: Etuvetidigene Autotemcel for the Treatment of Wiskott-Aldrich Syndrome
articles.authors: Ferrua F, Cenciarelli S, Giannelli S, Galimberti S, Chandrakasan S, Fraschetta F, Caputo C, Sala D, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome is a rare, X-linked, life-threatening inborn error of immunity and platelet disorder caused by variants in the gene WAS. Etuvetidigene autotemcel (etu-cel) is an autologous gene therapy consisting of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells that have been transduced ex vivo with a lentiviral vector encoding WAS complementary DNA.
abstract.textZh: Wiskott-Aldrich綜合症是一種罕見的、X連結的、威脅生命的先天性免疫錯誤和由基因變異引起的血小板紊亂。Etuvetidigene autotemcel (etu-cel)是一種自體基因療法，由造血幹細胞和祖細胞組成，這些細胞已在體外用編碼為互補DNA的慢病毒載體轉導。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We integrated data from two prospective open-label clinical studies (a phase 1-2 study with 8 participants and a phase 3 study with 10 participants) and an expanded-access program with 9 participants to evaluate the efficacy and safety of etu-cel in patients with Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome. The participants received a single intravenous infusion of etu-cel after rituximab administration and reduced-intensity conditioning. The primary efficacy end points were overall survival, severe infections from 6 to 18 months after gene therapy, and moderate and severe bleeding events in the first 12 months after gene therapy. Results for severe infections and moderate and severe bleeding are reported as the rate of events (number per person-year of observation), which was compared with the rate in the year before gene therapy.
abstract.textZh: 我們整合了兩項前瞻性開放標籤臨牀研究（一項有8名參與者的1-2期研究和一項有10名參與者的3期研究）和一項有9名參與者的擴大存取計劃的數據，以評估etu-cel在Wiskott-Aldrich綜合徵患者中的有效性和安全性。參與者在利妥昔單抗給藥和降低強度調節後接受單次靜脈輸注etu-cel。主要療效終點是總生存期、基因治療後6至18個月的嚴重感染，以及基因治療後前12個月的中度和重度出血事件。嚴重感染和中重度出血的結果以事件發生率（每人年觀察的數量）報告，並與基因治療前一年的發生率進行比較。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The median follow-up among the surviving participants was 5.7 years (range, 2.3 to 13.3), and the median age at the time of gene therapy was 2.6 years (range, 1.0 to 35.1). Overall survival at both 1 year and 5 years was 96%; one participant died. The most common adverse event of grade 3 or higher was central venous catheter-related infection. No evidence of insertional oncogenesis was observed. The rate of severe infections per person-year of observation decreased from 2.00 (95% confidence interval [CI], 1.50 to 2.61) in the year before gene therapy to 0.15 (95% CI, 0.04 to 0.39) in the period beyond 6 months up to 18 months after treatment. The rate of moderate or severe bleeding events per person-year of observation decreased from 2.00 (95% CI, 1.50 to 2.61) in the year before gene therapy to 0.80 (95% CI, 0.49 to 1.22) in the year after treatment.
abstract.textZh: 存活參與者的中位隨訪時間為5.7年（範圍為2.3至13.3 ） ，基因治療時的中位年齡為2.6年（範圍為1.0至35.1 ）。1年和5年的總生存率均為96% ； 1名參與者死亡。3級或以上最常見的不良事件是中心靜脈導管相關感染。未觀察到插入性腫瘤發生的證據。每人年觀察的嚴重感染率從基因治療前一年的2.00 （ 95 ％置信區間[CI] ， 1.50至2.61 ）降至治療後6個月至18個月以後的0.15 （ 95 ％ CI ， 0.04至0.39 ）。每人每年觀察的中度或重度出血事件發生率從基因治療前一年的2.00 （ 95% CI ， 1.50至2.61 ）降至治療後一年的0.80 （ 95% CI ， 0.49至1.22 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Our results show that the effects of etu-cel are consistent with a sustained clinical benefit in persons with Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome. (Funded by Fondazione Telethon and others; TIGET-WAS and OTL-103-4 ClinicalTrials.gov numbers, NCT01515462 and NCT03837483, respectively.).
abstract.textZh: 我們的結果表明， etu-cel的影響與Wiskott-Aldrich綜合徵患者的持續臨牀益處一致。（由Fondazione Telethon等資助； TIGET-WAS和OTL-103-4 ClinicalTrials.gov編號、NCT01515462和NCT03837483 ）。

articles.title: Phase 1 Study of Anito-cel, a d-Domain BCMA CAR T Cell for Refractory or Recurrent Myeloma
articles.authors: Frigault MJ, Dhakal B, Jakubowiak AJ, Raje N, Banerjee K, Mu CJ, Hart KC, Shachar S, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Anitocabtagene autoleucel (anito-cel), a B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA)-directed autologous chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy with a synthetic d-domain binder (ddBCMA), may have efficacy in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.
abstract.textZh: Anitocabtagene autoleucel （ anito-cel ）是一種B細胞成熟抗原（ BCMA ）定向的自體嵌合抗原受體（ CAR ） T細胞療法，使用合成d-域結合劑（ ddBCMA ） ，可能對復發或難治性多發性骨髓瘤患者有效。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a phase 1 study, we evaluated the safety and efficacy of anito-cel (dose level 1, 100×106 CAR+ T cells; dose level 2, 300×106 CAR+ T cells) in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who had received three or more lines of therapy previously or had triple-class refractory disease. Primary end points were adverse events during the treatment period and establishment of the recommended phase 2 dose. In complementary in vitro studies, we compared the anito-cel ddBCMA binder with a dual variable heavy-chain domain of a heavy chain-only antibody (dual-VHH) binder corresponding to the published sequence for ciltacabtagene autoleucel.
abstract.textZh: 在一項1期研究中，我們評估了anito-cel （劑量等級1 ， 100 × 106 CAR + T細胞；劑量等級2 ， 300 × 106 CAR + T細胞）在復發或難治性多發性骨髓瘤患者中的安全性和有效性，這些患者先前接受過三線或以上的治療或患有三級難治性疾病。主要終點是治療期間和推薦的第2階段劑量建立期間的不良事件。在互補的體外研究中，我們將anito-cel ddBCMA結合劑與對應於ciltacabtagene autoleucel的已發表序列的僅重鏈抗體（ dual-VHH ）結合劑的雙重可變重鏈域進行了比較。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 40 patients enrolled, 38 received anito-cel. All 38 patients had an adverse event during the treatment period, and 37 patients (97%) had an adverse event of grade 3 or higher. Among patients who received the recommended phase 2 dose (100×106 CAR+ T cells), 94% had cytokine release syndrome of grade 1 or 2, with no events of grade 3 or higher. A total of 16% of the patients had immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) of grade 1 or 2, and 1 patient (3%) had a grade 3 event. No non-ICANS or delayed neurotoxic effects occurred. At a median follow-up of 38.1 months, all 38 patients (100%) had had a response, with 79% having a complete response. The 24-month progression-free survival was 57%; the median progression-free survival was 30.2 months. The 36-month overall survival was 65%. The ddBCMA binder had a faster off-rate than the dual-VHH binder; although cytotoxicity was similar with the two therapies, ddBCMA CAR T cells led to less cytokine release and did not result in activation without antigen or in off-target cytotoxic effects.
abstract.textZh: 在招募的40名患者中， 38名接受了anito-cel。 所有38名患者在治療期間發生不良事件， 37名患者（ 97 ％ ）發生3級或以上的不良事件。 在接受推薦的第2階段劑量(100 × 106 CAR + T細胞)的患者中， 94%有1級或2級的細胞因子釋放綜合徵，沒有3級或更高的事件。 共有16%的患者患有1級或2級的免疫效應細胞相關神經毒性綜合徵(ICANS) ， 1名患者(3%)發生3級事件。 未發生非ICANS或延遲神經毒性作用。 在中位隨訪38.1個月時，所有38名患者（ 100% ）均有緩解，其中79%有完全緩解。 24個月無惡化生存期為57% ；中位數無惡化生存期為30.2個月。 36個月的總生存率為65%。 DdBCMA結合劑具有比雙VHH結合劑更快的關閉速率；雖然細胞毒性與兩種療法相似，但ddBCMA CAR T細胞導致較少的細胞因子釋放，並且不會導致沒有抗原的活化或產生脫靶細胞毒性作用。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Anito-cel therapy led to a high incidence of response among patients with heavily pretreated relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Cytokine release syndrome and ICANS of grade 3 or higher were rare. (Funded by Arcellx and Kite, a Gilead company; ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04155749.).
abstract.textZh: Anito-cel治療導致嚴重預治復發或難治性多發性骨髓瘤患者的高反應發生率。細胞因子釋放症候羣和3級或以上的ICANS很少見。（由Gilead旗下公司Arcellx和Kite資助； ClinicalTrials.gov編號為NCT04155749。）

articles.title: Oveporexton for Narcolepsy Type 1 - Results from Two Phase 3 Trials
articles.authors: Dauvilliers Y, Mignot E, Antczak J, Arnulf I, Barateau L, Buntinx E, Corser B, Iranzo A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Narcolepsy type 1 is characterized by excessive daytime sleepiness, cataplexy, disrupted sleep, sleep paralysis, and hypnagogic or hypnopompic hallucinations. Oveporexton (TAK-861), an oral orexin receptor 2-selective agonist, reduced symptoms of narcolepsy type 1 in a previous phase 2 trial.
abstract.textZh: 1型嗜睡症的特徵是白天過度嗜睡、癱瘓、睡眠中斷、睡眠癱瘓和催眠或催眠幻覺。Oveporexton (TAK-861)是一種口服食欲素受體2-選擇性激動劑，在之前的2期試驗中減輕了1型嗜睡症的症狀。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted two phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled trials evaluating the efficacy and safety of oveporexton over a period of 12 weeks. Participants 16 to 70 years of age with narcolepsy type 1 were randomly assigned in a 3:3:2 ratio to receive twice-daily oveporexton (1 mg or 2 mg) or placebo in the First Light trial and in a 2:1 ratio to receive twice-daily oveporexton (2 mg) or placebo in the Radiant Light trial. The primary end point was the change from baseline to week 12 in mean sleep latency (the ability to stay awake under soporific conditions) on the Maintenance of Wakefulness Test (MWT; range, 0 to 40 minutes; normal, ≥20). Key secondary end points included the change from baseline to week 12 in the Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS) total score (range, 0 to 24; normal, ≤10) and the weekly cataplexy rate at week 12.
abstract.textZh: 我們進行了兩項3期、隨機、安慰劑對照試驗，評估oveporexton在12週內的療效和安全性。在First Light試驗中， 16至70歲的1型嗜睡症參與者以3 ： 3 ： 2的比例隨機分配接受每日兩次的oveporexton （ 1毫克或2毫克）或安慰劑，在Radiant Light試驗中以2 ： 1的比例接受每日兩次的oveporexton （ 2毫克）或安慰劑。主要終點是保持清醒測試（ MWT ；範圍為0至40分鐘；正常， ≥ 20 ）的平均睡眠潛伏期（在休眠條件下保持清醒的能力）從基線到第12週的變化。次要關鍵終點包括Epworth嗜睡量表(ESS)總分(範圍0至24 ；正常， ≤ 10)從基線到第12週的變化，以及第12週的每週猝發率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 168 participants were enrolled in the First Light trial and 105 in the Radiant Light trial. Mean changes from baseline to week 12 in mean sleep latency on the MWT ranged from 14.3 to 19.8 minutes with oveporexton, as compared with -0.4 to -0.8 minutes with placebo (adjusted P<0.001 for all comparisons vs. placebo). Mean changes in the ESS total score ranged from -9.7 to -11.8 with oveporexton, as compared with -1.5 to -1.7 with placebo (adjusted P<0.001 for all comparisons vs. placebo). Median percent reductions in the weekly cataplexy rate ranged from 79.0 to 88.8% with oveporexton, as compared with 27.7 to 39.1% with placebo (adjusted P<0.001 for all comparisons vs. placebo). Adverse events occurred in 86 to 89% of the participants with oveporexton, as compared with 43 to 54% with placebo; the most common adverse events were increased urinary frequency and transient insomnia, which occurred in a majority of participants receiving oveporexton.
abstract.textZh: First Light試驗共招募了168名參與者， Radiant Light試驗共招募了105名參與者。MWT的平均睡眠潛伏期從基線到第12週的平均變化範圍為oveporexton為14.3至19.8分鐘，而安慰劑為-0.4至-0.8分鐘（所有比較與安慰劑的調整P < 0.001 ）。使用oveporexton時ESS總分數的平均變化範圍為-9.7至-11.8 ，而使用安慰劑時為-1.5至-1.7 （與安慰劑相比，所有比較的調整後P < 0.001 ）。與安慰劑相比， oveporexton的每週猝發率中位數百分比降低幅度為79.0%至88.8% （與安慰劑相比，所有比較的調整後P < 0.001 ）。86%至89%的oveporexton參與者發生不良事件，而安慰劑為43%至54% ；最常見的不良事件是尿頻增加和短暫性失眠，這發生在大多數接受oveporexton治療的參與者身上。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Over a period of 12 weeks, oveporexton significantly improved measures of wakefulness, sleepiness, and cataplexy in participants with narcolepsy type 1. Increased urinary frequency and transient insomnia were common side effects. (Funded by Takeda Development Center Americas; the First Light and Radiant Light ClinicalTrials.gov numbers, NCT06470828 and NCT06505031.).
abstract.textZh: 在12週的時間內， oveporexton顯著改善了1型嗜睡症參與者的清醒、嗜睡和猝發症的測量。尿頻增加和短暫失眠是常見的副作用。（由武田開發中心美洲資助； First Light and Radiant Light ClinicalTrials.gov編號、NCT06470828和NCT06505031。）

articles.titleZh: Oveporexton治療嗜睡症1型-兩項3期試驗的結果

articles.title: Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation with Intermediate Stroke Risk
articles.authors: Kim D, Lee YS, Shim J, Yu HT, Park J, Park JK, Oh IY, Kang KW, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Current U.S. and European guidelines recommend oral anticoagulation as a class IIa indication in patients with atrial fibrillation at intermediate risk for stroke; however, evidence from randomized trials is needed.
abstract.textZh: 目前的美國和歐洲指南建議將口服抗凝藥物作為中風風險中等的心房顫動患者的IIA級適應症；然而，需要隨機試驗的證據。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a multicenter, open-label, adjudicator-masked superiority trial in South Korea involving patients with atrial fibrillation and an intermediate risk of stroke (a score of 1 in men and 2 in women on the CHA2DS2-VASc scale; range, 0 to 9, with higher scores indicating a greater risk of stroke). Patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) therapy or no anticoagulation. The primary end point was a composite of stroke, systemic embolism, major bleeding, or death from cardiovascular causes at 24 months.
abstract.textZh: 我們在韓國進行了一項多中心、開放標籤、裁定者遮蔽優勢試驗，涉及心房顫動和中度卒中風險的患者（ CHA2DS2-VASc量表的男性和女性得分為1分，女性得分為2分；範圍為0至9分，分數越高表明卒中風險越高）。患者以1: 1的比例被隨機分配接受直接口服抗凝劑(DOAC)治療或不接受抗凝劑治療。主要終點是24個月時的中風、全身性栓塞、嚴重出血或死於心血管疾病的綜合症。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 1803 patients who underwent randomization, 902 were assigned to receive DOAC therapy and 901 were assigned to receive no anticoagulant therapy. The mean age of the patients was 60.4 years, and 23.7% were women. At 24 months, a primary end-point event had occurred in 4 patients (cumulative incidence, 0.5%) in the DOAC group and in 13 (cumulative incidence, 1.5%) in the no-anticoagulant group (difference, -1.0 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -2.0 to -0.1; P = 0.03; hazard ratio, 0.31; 95% CI, 0.10 to 0.94). Stroke occurred in 3 patients (cumulative incidence, 0.3%) in the DOAC group and in 10 (cumulative incidence, 1.1%) in the no-anticoagulant group. The incidence of systemic embolism and major bleeding appeared to be similar in the two trial groups, and no deaths from cardiovascular causes occurred in either group. Serious adverse events occurred in 80 patients (8.9%) in the DOAC group and in 84 (9.3%) in the no-anticoagulant group.
abstract.textZh: 在接受隨機分組的1803名患者中， 902名被分配接受DOAC治療， 901名被分配不接受抗凝治療。患者的平均年齡為60.4歲，女性為23.7%。在24個月時， DOAC組的4名患者（累積發生率， 0.5% ）和無抗凝血劑組的13名患者（累積發生率， 1.5% ）發生了主要終點事件（差異， -1.0個百分點； 95%置信區間[CI] ， -2.0至-0.1 ； P = 0.03 ；風險比率， 0.31 ； 95% CI ， 0.10至0.94 ）。DOAC組有3名患者發生中風（累積發生率， 0.3% ） ，非抗凝血組有10名患者發生中風（累積發生率， 1.1% ）。兩個試驗組的全身性栓塞和大出血發生率似乎相似，兩組均未發生心血管疾病死亡。嚴重不良事件發生在DOAC組的80名患者（ 8.9% ）和非抗凝血組的84名患者（ 9.3% ）中。

articles.title: Faecal microbiota transplantation in irritable bowel syndrome (REFIT2): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Johnsen PH, Juul FE, Hoff DAL, Hillestad ER, Holme Ø, Skjevling LK, Hansen HM, Rasmus MH, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Gut microbiota composition might have a role in the pathogenesis of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and faecal microbiota transplantation has been proposed as a means of restoring healthy gut microbiota for individuals with this condition. We aimed to investigate the efficacy and safety of faecal microbiota transplantation in patients with IBS.
abstract.textZh: 腸道微生物羣組成可能在腸易激綜合症（ IBS ）的發病機制中發揮作用，並且已經提出將糞便微生物羣移植作為恢復患有這種情況的個體的健康腸道微生物羣的一種手段。我們旨在調查IBS患者糞便微生物羣移植的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this parallel-group, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial, conducted at five hospitals in Norway, we enrolled men and women aged 18-65 years with moderate-to-severe IBS. IBS diagnosis was defined by the Rome IV criteria and an IBS-Severity Scoring System (IBS-SSS) score of 175 points or higher. A colonoscopy within 5 years before study enrolment was required for all participants aged 50 years or older to rule out colorectal cancer, and participants with IBS with predominantly diarrhoea required negative biopsies to exclude microscopic colitis. Participants were randomly assigned 2:1 to faecal microbiota transplantation with faeces samples from either healthy donors (intervention) or the participants themselves (placebo group). All investigators, participants, and study personnel involved in treatment administration, patient care, and outcome assessment were masked to treatment allocation throughout the study. Treatments were delivered as a once-only rectal enema. The primary endpoint was the proportion of participants with a reduction of 75 points or more in IBS-SSS score at 90 days after treatment compared with baseline, assessed in all patients who received their allocated treatment. All participants were advised to report any adverse event during follow-up to their study contact, preferably by telephone. A patient representative was involved in the planning of the trial. The trial was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04691544).
abstract.textZh: 在這項在挪威五家醫院進行的平行組、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、3期試驗中，我們招募了18-65歲中度至重度IBS的男性和女性。 根據羅馬IV標準和175分或更高的IBS嚴重程度評分系統（ IBS-SSS ）評分來定義IBS診斷。 所有50歲或以上的參與者需要在研究入組前5年內進行結腸鏡檢查以排除結腸直腸癌，而患有主要腹瀉的IBS參與者需要陰性活組織檢查以排除微觀結腸炎。 參與者以2 ： 1的比例隨機分配給糞便微生物羣移植，其中糞便樣本來自健康捐贈者（幹預）或參與者本身（安慰劑組）。 在整個研究期間，所有參與治療給藥、患者護理和結果評估的研究人員、參與者和研究人員都被隱藏在治療分配中。 治療以一次性直腸灌腸的方式進行。 主要終點是治療後90天IBS-SSS評分與基線相比降低75分或以上的參與者比例，在所有接受分配治療的患者中進行評估。 建議所有參與者在研究接觸後的隨訪期間報告任何不良事件，最好是通過電話。 一名患者代表參與了試驗的規劃。 試驗在ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04691544)註冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between May 5, 2021, and July 14, 2022, we assessed 2304 individuals for eligibility, and 450 participants were enrolled and randomly assigned to the intervention group (299) or placebo group (151); two randomly assigned participants were excluded from analyses because their allocated treatments were switched. 293 (65%) of 448 participants were women, 155 (35%) were men, and the median age was 36 years (IQR 29-44). 119 (40%) participants in the donor faecal microbiota transplantation group and 57 (38%) in the placebo group showed an improvement of at least 75 points on the IBS-SSS at 90 days after treatment. The absolute difference was 1·9 percentage points (95% CI -8·1 to 12·0; p=0·76). The proportion of participants with adverse events was similar in the two study groups.
abstract.textZh: 在2021年5月5日至2022年7月14日期間，我們評估了2304名個體的資格，並將450名參與者入組並隨機分配到幹預組（ 299 ）或安慰劑組（ 151 ） ；兩名隨機分配的參與者因其分配的治療被切換而被排除在分析之外。448名參與者中有293名（ 65 ％ ）為女性， 155名（ 35 ％ ）為男性，中位年齡為36歲（ IQR 29-44 ）。供體糞便微生物羣移植組中的119名（ 40 ％ ）參與者和安慰劑組中的57名（ 38 ％ ）在治療後90天顯示IBS-SSS改善至少75分。絕對差異為1 · 9個百分點（ 95% CI -8 · 1至12 · 0 ； p = 0 · 76 ）。兩個研究組中發生不良事件的參與者比例相似。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: The trial did not show a clinical benefit of faecal microbiota transplantation in patients with IBS. These findings suggest that microbiota modulation alone might be insufficient for symptom improvement in IBS.
abstract.textZh: 該試驗並未顯示IBS患者糞便微生物羣移植的臨牀益處。這些發現表明，單靠微生物羣調節可能不足以改善IBS的症狀。

articles.title: Tenecteplase Before Thrombectomy at 4.5 to 24 Hours for Basilar Artery Occlusion: The ATTENTION LATE Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Li R, Yao X, Nogueira RG, Yuan G, Chen Z, Chen W, Yi T, Ren Y, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Whether intravenous tenecteplase before endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) improves outcomes in patients with basilar artery occlusion presenting 4.5 to 24 hours after stroke onset remains uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 血管內血栓切除(EVT)前靜脈注射替奈普酶是否能改善中風發作後4.5至24小時出現基底動脈阻塞的患者的預後仍不確定。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of intravenous tenecteplase before EVT vs EVT alone in patients with moderate to severe basilar artery occlusion admitted within 4.5 to 24 hours from stroke onset.
abstract.textZh: 在卒中發作後4.5至24小時內入院的中度至重度基底動脈閉塞患者中，評估EVT前與單獨EVT前靜脈注射替奈普酶的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This multicenter, open-label, blinded end point, randomized clinical trial was conducted at 40 stroke centers in China. Between March 16, 2023, and February 4, 2025, a total of 330 patients with moderate to severe basilar artery occlusion (National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale score ≥10) presenting within 4.5 to 24 hours from stroke onset to EVT-capable centers were enrolled. Final follow-up was completed on May 4, 2025.
abstract.textZh: 這項多中心、開放標籤、盲法終點、隨機臨牀試驗在中國40個腦卒中中心進行。在2023年3月16日至2025年2月4日期間，共招募了330名中度至重度基底動脈阻塞（美國國立衛生研究院中風量表分數≥ 10 ）患者，從中風發作到有EVT能力的中心在4.5至24小時內出現。最終追蹤已於2025年5月4日完成。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Patients were randomized 1:1 via a centralized web server using a minimization method to receive either intravenous tenecteplase (bolus injection, 0.25 mg/kg; maximum, 25 mg) followed by EVT (n = 166) or EVT alone (n = 164).
abstract.textZh: 患者透過使用最小化方法的集中式網頁伺服器進行1: 1隨機分組，接受靜脈注射替奈普酶（推注， 0.25 mg/kg ；最大值， 25 mg ） ，然後依序進行EVT （ n = 166 ）或單獨進行EVT （ n = 164 ）。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was functional independence (modified Rankin Scale score, 0-2) at 90 days. Safety outcomes included symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage and 90-day mortality.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果為90天時的功能獨立性（改良Rankin量表評分， 0-2 ）。安全性結果包括症狀性顱內出血和90天死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 332 patients randomized, 2 withdrew consent. Of the remaining 330 patients (mean [SD] age, 66 [11] years; 241 males [73%]; 89 females [27%]), 329 completed 90-day follow-up. Of whom, 50 of 165 (30%) in the tenecteplase plus EVT group and 50 of 164 (30%) in the EVT alone group achieved functional independence (adjusted rate ratio, 0.92 [95% CI, 0.67 to 1.25]; risk difference, -0.18% [95% CI, -10.13% to 9.76%]). Symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage occurred in 8 patients (5%) in the tenecteplase plus EVT group and 6 (4%) in the EVT alone group. Mortality at 90 days was similar between the groups (66 [40%] vs 70 [43%], respectively).

abstract.text: Among patients with moderate to severe basilar artery occlusion admitted directly to EVT-capable centers who presented 4.5 to 24 hours after stroke onset, the addition of intravenous tenecteplase before EVT did not result in improved functional outcomes compared with EVT alone.

articles.title: Effect of Screening with Multicancer Early-Detection Test on Late-Stage Cancer Diagnosis
articles.authors: Sasieni P, Johnson P, Round T, Warwick J, Jones H, Dolly S, Lee L, Lee Y, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Whether screening with blood-based early-detection tests for multiple cancers in addition to usual care has clinical utility is unknown.
abstract.textZh: 除了日常護理外，對多種癌症進行血液早期檢測篩查是否具有臨牀實用性尚不清楚。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a randomized, controlled trial conducted in England, we obtained peripheral blood from persons 50 to 77 years of age at up to three annual visits. After baseline blood collection, participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to the intervention group (participants whose blood was tested) or the control group (participants whose blood was stored). Participants and trial personnel were initially unaware of the group assignments. The primary end point was stage III or IV cancer among 12 prespecified types of cancer, and a key secondary end point was stage IV cancer among the 12 prespecified types. The differences between the groups in the incidence rate (the number of first eligible events divided by person-years at risk) were measured after three screening rounds and at least 12 months of follow-up after the last participant's third visit.
abstract.textZh: 在英國進行的一項隨機、對照試驗中，我們在至多三次年度回診中從50至77歲的人羣中獲得外周血。基線期血液採集後，參與者以1: 1的比例被隨機分配到幹預組（接受血液測試的參與者）或對照組（儲存血液的參與者）。參與者和試驗人員最初不知道小組分配。在12種預先指定的癌症類型中，主要終點是III期或IV期癌症，而在12種預先指定的癌症類型中，關鍵次要終點是IV期癌症。在三次篩選回合和最後一位參與者第三次回診後至少12個月的追蹤後，測量各組之間的發生率差異（第一次合格事件的數量除以風險人年）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Overall, 71,122 participants were randomly assigned to the intervention group and 71,128 to the control group. The incidence rate of stage III or IV cancer (primary end point) did not differ significantly between the groups (incidence rate ratio [intervention vs. control], 1.03; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.92 to 1.14, P = 0.63). The incidence rate ratio for stage IV cancer (a key secondary end point) after 3 screening rounds was 0.86 (95% CI, 0.74 to 1.00). Less than 1% of participants had trial-related adverse events; none were serious.
abstract.textZh: 總體而言， 71,122名參與者被隨機分配到幹預組， 71,128名參與者被隨機分配到對照組。III期或IV期癌症（主要終點）的發生率在各組之間沒有顯著差異（發生率比率[幹預對照] ， 1.03 ； 95%可信區間[CI] ， 0.92至1.14 ， P = 0.63 ）。3輪篩選後IV期癌症（關鍵次要終點）的發病率比率為0.86 （ 95% CI ， 0.74至1.00 ）。不到1%的受試者出現與試驗相關的不良事件；沒有嚴重不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In this trial, we did not observe a lower incidence rate of stage III or IV cancers across 12 prespecified cancers after three screening rounds with multicancer early-detection testing plus usual care than with usual care alone. Further follow-up is warranted to assess the way in which findings for stage III or IV cancers and the between-group difference in stage IV cancers evolve over time. (Funded by Grail; NHS-Galleri ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05611632; ISRCTN number, ISRCTN91431511.).
abstract.textZh: 在這項試驗中，我們並未觀察到12種預先指定癌症的III期或IV期癌症發生率在三次篩選回合後，通過多癌早期檢測加上常規護理，比單獨使用常規護理更低。需要進一步追蹤以評估III期或IV期癌症的發現以及IV期癌症的組間差異隨著時間演變的方式。（由GRAIL資助； NHS-Galleri ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05611632 ； ISRCTN編號， ISRCTN91431511。）。

articles.title: Tobacco Use Treatment: Synopsis of the 2026 U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and U.S. Department of Defense Clinical Practice Guideline
articles.authors: Myers MG, Vu PA, Calhoun PS, Chen T, Cook JW, Fu SS, Geraci MC, Hayes JA, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: A work group representing the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) prepared a new VA/DoD clinical practice guideline (CPG) for tobacco use treatment. This article provides a synopsis of the 2026 CPG, which addresses use of commercially available tobacco and nicotine products.
abstract.textZh: 代表美國退伍軍人事務部（ VA ）和美國國防部（ DoD ）的工作組準備了新的VA/DoD煙草使用治療臨牀實踐指南（ CPG ）。本文概述了2026年消費物價指數，其中涉及市售煙草和尼古丁產品的使用。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: A multidisciplinary work group developed 19 key questions on clinical topics of highest priority for the VA and DoD populations. Published literature from 1 January 2014 to 10 December 2024 was systematically reviewed using the PICOTS (population, intervention, comparator, outcomes, timing of outcomes measurement, and setting) framework. Recommendations were made by consensus and informed by evaluation using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) method, which assesses quality of evidence and balances benefits and harms, patient preferences, and feasibility. The final document incorporated input from peer review by an external group of experts.
abstract.textZh: 一個多學科工作小組針對退伍軍人管理局和國防部人羣的最高優先臨牀主題制定了19個關鍵問題。2014年1月1日至2024年12月10日期間發表的文獻使用PICOT （人口、幹預、比較器、結果、結果測量時間和設定）框架進行了系統性審查。建議以共識方式提出，並使用GRADE （建議評估，開發和評估的評級）方法進行評估，該方法評估證據的質量並平衡利益和傷害，患者偏好和可行性。最終文件納入了外部專家小組同行評審的意見。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: The 2026 guideline includes 32 recommendations across 10 topic areas. Key recommendations for increasing abstinence from combustible tobacco include recommending motivational interviewing to increase engagement in treatment of tobacco and nicotine use (strong) and use of U.S. Food and Drug Administration-approved pharmacotherapies (strong), with varenicline recommended over monotherapy with other agents (strong), combination nicotine replacement therapy ([NRT] for example, patch plus lozenge) recommended over NRT monotherapy (single agent) (strong), and extending use of bupropion sustained release beyond 12 weeks (weak). Other key recommendations include varenicline for increasing abstinence from smokeless tobacco (strong) and electronic nicotine delivery systems (weak) and use of NRT or varenicline to increase quit attempts and abstinence in patients not ready to quit in the next 30 days (weak).
abstract.textZh: 2026年準則包括10個主題領域的32項建議。增加可燃煙草禁慾的主要建議包括建議進行動機訪談，以增加對煙草和尼古丁使用的治療（強）和使用美國食品和藥物管理局批準的藥物治療（強） ，建議使用伐尼克林而不是使用其他藥物進行單一治療（強） ，建議使用尼古丁替代療法（ [NRT]例如，貼片加錠劑）而不是NRT單一治療（單一藥物） （強） ，並將丁丙酮持續釋放的使用延長至12週以後（弱）。其他主要建議包括伐尼克蘭增加無煙煙草（強）和電子尼古丁輸送系統（弱）的禁慾，以及使用NRT或伐尼克蘭增加戒菸嘗試和未準備好在未來30天內戒菸的患者禁慾（弱）。

articles.title: Factors influencing implementation of decarbonisation actions in general practice: longitudinal multi-centre case-study
articles.authors: Twohig H, Geddes O, Dale J, Dahlmann F, Earle J, Eccles A, Gregg M, Nunes AR, et al.

abstract.text: Background The National Health Service (NHS) aims to reach net zero by 2040. Although recognised as having a key role, little is known about how decarbonisation initiatives are implemented in general practice and how progress can be supported. Aim To explore the institutional, organisational and professional factors that influence implementation of decarbonisation actions in general practice over time. Design and setting Longitudinal qualitative case study in 12 general practices in England. Methods Practices developed a Green Action Plan (GAP) comprising 3-5 measurable actions to be implemented over 12 months. Qualitative data were collected through baseline workshops, 3-monthly follow‑up 'check-in' discussions and final focus groups. Topic guides were iteratively developed, informed by Normalisation Process Theory and the Theoretical Domains Framework, and Framework analysis was conducted Results The factors influencing decarbonisation are presented as five themes: systemic barriers; culture and communication; capacity and competing demands; 'making it work'; and behaviour, attitudes and feelings. Actions aligned with wider NHS priorities or offering time/financial efficiency were easier to embed, whereas those requiring individual behaviour change or reliant on external systems were more challenging. Lack of coordinated policy support and limited control over estates and infrastructure constrained progress. Conclusion At practice level, actions that integrate into routine work and provide efficiency gains are most feasible in enacting change. To support sustained change, directive national policies and coordinated system-level support are required. Individual behaviour change is challenging in an already pressured system, but a supportive culture and team collaboration can facilitate progress.

articles.title: Prescriber Practices and Barriers to Providing Prescription Medication Instructions for Patients With a Non-English Language Preference
articles.authors: Manzor B, Ramírez JL, Lanchoney OWL, Collins V, Hughey KL

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Patients in the United States with limited English proficiency, referred to as a non-English language preference, are at risk for serious negative medication-related outcomes. Evidence suggests that these negative outcomes are associated with miscommunication of prescription medication instructions between prescribers and patients and between prescribers and dispensing pharmacies. We sought to explore relevant practices and barriers.
abstract.textZh: 美國英語水平有限的患者（稱為非英語偏好）有嚴重藥物相關不良結果的風險。有證據表明，這些負面結果與處方者和患者之間以及處方者和配藥藥房之間處方藥物說明溝通不暢有關。我們試圖探索相關做法和障礙。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We recruited outpatient prescribers from a large academic medical health center via an e-mail listserv. We developed and distributed a questionnaire to identify prescribers' practices, barriers, and interactions with patients, interpreters, and pharmacies regarding provision of non-English prescription medication instructions.
abstract.textZh: 我們通過電子郵件列表服務器從大型學術醫療保健中心招募門診處方師。我們開發並分發了一份問卷，以確定處方者在提供非英語處方藥物說明方面的做法、障礙以及與患者、口譯員和藥房的互動。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 477 e-mail addresses on the listserv, 169 (35.4%) prescribers completed the questionnaire. The prescribers were predominantly White (73.4%), female (75.7%), and physicians (doctors of medicine or doctors of osteopathic medicine, 86.0%), and they had an average age of 41.0 years. The majority (61.5%) reported a lack of awareness of best practices to provide non-English instructions to patients or pharmacies, and most (91.8%) did not inform patients that they could request a non-English medication label from their pharmacy. Many prescribers (69.8%) did not feel confident that their patients with a non-English language preference received accurate written medication instructions.
abstract.textZh: 在清單服務器上的477個電子郵件地址中，有169名（ 35.4 ％ ）處方者填寫了問卷。處方者以白人(73.4%)、女性(75.7%)和醫生(醫生或骨科醫生， 86.0%)為主，平均年齡為41.0歲。大多數（ 61.5 ％ ）報告缺乏對向患者或藥房提供非英語說明的最佳做法的認識，大多數（ 91.8 ％ ）沒有告知患者他們可以向藥房申請非英語藥物標籤。許多處方者（ 69.8% ）對非英語偏好的患者收到正確的書面用藥說明沒有信心。

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Quality improvement (QI) is a core component of family medicine residency training, preparing physicians to lead system-level changes and deliver value-based care. However, there is no standardized curriculum or metric for evaluating success of residency QI projects and a lack of consensus on best practices for QI education and assessment in graduate medical education. We sought to characterize the current landscape of QI curricula in US family medicine residencies, including pedagogic methods, project requirements, faculty roles, and perceived markers of success and barriers.
abstract.textZh: 質量改善（ QI ）是家庭醫學住院醫師培訓的核心組成部分，為醫師領導系統級變革和提供以價值為基礎的護理做好準備。然而，沒有標準化的課程或指標來評估住院QI項目的成功，也缺乏對研究生醫學教育中QI教育和評估的最佳實踐的共識。我們試圖描述美國家庭醫學住院醫師目前的QI課程環境，包括教學方法、項目要求、教師角色以及成功和障礙的感知標誌。

abstract.text: This study was part of the 2025 Council of Academic Family Medicine Educational Research Alliance cross-sectional survey of family medicine residency program directors. Survey question topics included QI training, project logistics, characteristics, and outcomes. We analyzed data by descriptive statistics and χ2 analyses.

articles.title: Identifying Hazardous Alcohol Use in Primary Care: Concordance Between Phosphatidylethanol and Self-Reports
articles.authors: Månsson V, Hammarberg A, Guterstam J, LoMartire R

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Screening for hazardous alcohol use is a challenging task in primary care. We examined concordance between the alcohol biomarker phosphatidylethanol (PEth) and 2 self-reported measures of alcohol use-score on a screening questionnaire and weekly drinks-in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 在初級保健中，篩查有害酒精使用是一項具有挑戰性的任務。我們檢查了酒精生物標誌物磷脂酰乙醇（ PEth ）和2項自我報告的酒精使用量度之間的一致性-篩選問卷和每週飲酒-初級保健。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using regional primary care health records linked to national registries in Sweden. Analyses used 2 samples: (1) patients with a PEth test who also had an Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test (AUDIT) score in the preceding or following 90 days (n = 3,679) and (2) patients with a PEth test who also had a documented self-reported weekly alcohol use in the preceding or following 90 days (n = 8,934). We defined hazardous alcohol use as a PEth level of greater than 210 ng/mL (0.30 μmol/L), an AUDIT score of 8 or higher, and a reported consumption of 10 or more drinks per week. Associations between PEth and self-reports were examined using correlation analyses and proportional-odds models adjusted for sociodemographic and clinical characteristics.
abstract.textZh: 我們使用與瑞典國家登記處相關的區域初級保健健康記錄進行了回溯性隊列研究。分析使用了2個樣本： (1)在90天之前或之後也進行酒精使用障礙識別測試(AUDIT)評分的PEth測試患者(n = 3,679)和(2)在90天之前或之後也進行有記錄的每週自我報告酒精使用的PEth測試患者(n = 8,934)。我們將有害酒精使用定義為PEth水平高於210 ng/mL (0.30 μmol/L)、稽核分數為8分或更高，以及每週飲用10杯或更多飲料。使用相關性分析和根據社會人口和臨牀特徵調整的比例ODDS模型檢查PEth和自我報告之間的關聯。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The prevalence of hazardous alcohol use varied substantially by assessment method. The AUDIT questionnaire classified the largest proportion of patients as having hazardous use (26.5%), followed by PEth level (14.6% and 18.3% in the first and second samples, respectively) and by reported weekly drinks (8.5%). Each method identified patients not detected by the others. PEth levels correlated moderately with both AUDIT scores and weekly alcohol consumption, but relationships were nonlinear. At similar PEth levels, men and patients with higher education or income reported greater weekly alcohol use, while younger patients had higher AUDIT scores.
abstract.textZh: 使用有害酒精的普遍程度因評估方法而異。稽核問卷將最大比例的患者分類為有危險使用（ 26.5 ％ ） ，其次是PEth水平（第一和第二個樣本分別為14.6 ％和18.3 ％ ）以及每週報告的飲料（ 8.5 ％ ）。每種方法都能識別出其他方法未檢測到的患者。PEth水平與稽核分數和每週飲酒量均有中度相關性，但關係是非線性的。在類似的PEth水平下，受過高等教育或收入的男性和患者報告每週酒精使用量較高，而年輕患者的稽核分數較高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: An alcohol biomarker and self-reported measures capture overlapping but distinct aspects of alcohol use in primary care. For primary care clinicians, PEth should be interpreted alongside self-reported measures rather than used as a standalone test. Combining assessment methods may improve identification of alcohol-related risk and support more individualized, context-sensitive clinical conversations.
abstract.textZh: 酒精生物標誌物和自我報告的措施捕捉了初級保健中酒精使用的重疊但截然不同的方面。對於初級保健臨牀醫生， PEth應與自我報告的措施一起解釋，而不是用作獨立測試。結合評估方法可以改善酒精相關風險的識別，並支持更個性化、上下文敏感的臨牀對話。

articles.title: Assessing 5-Year Outcomes of a Teamlet Care Model in Singapore Polyclinics: A Matched Difference-in-Difference Analysis
articles.authors: Wye Wong SK, Tan KB, Pang J, Wong V, Liang Ng DW, Yung Tan DH, Lim Z, Sundram M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: A novel teamlet (small team) care model was introduced in 2014 within Singapore polyclinics to improve care continuity and comprehensiveness for patients with chronic disease. Patients were enrolled in smaller teams comprising 2 family physicians, 1 nurse, and 1 care coordinator for coordinated team-based care. This study assessed 5-year outcomes focusing on clinical parameters, care adherence, health care utilization, and economic impact.
abstract.textZh: 2014年，新加坡多家診所引入了一種新的teamlet （小團隊）護理模式，以改善慢性病患者的護理連續性和全面性。患者被招募到較小的團隊中，包括2名家庭醫生、1名護士和1名護理協調員，以協調團隊為基礎的護理。本研究評估了5年結果，重點是臨牀參數、護理依從性、醫療保健利用率和經濟影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a retrospective matched cohort study of patients with diabetes, hypertension, or hyperlipidemia enrolled in the teamlet program from 2014 to 2016. Outcomes were compared with matched control patients receiving usual care. We analyzed data from Singapore's Ministry of Health databases using difference-in-differences analysis, controlling for individual and cohort-time fixed effects.
abstract.textZh: 我們對2014年至2016年參與teamlet計劃的糖尿病、高血壓或高脂血症患者進行了回顧性匹配隊列研究。將結果與接受常規護理的匹配對照患者進行比較。我們使用差異分析來分析來自新加坡衛生部數據庫的數據，控制個人和隊列時間固定效應。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The teamlet model achieved modest clinical improvements; glycated hemoglobin decreased by 0.1% for subgroups with nonincreasing HbA1c before empanelment, systolic blood pressure decreased by 0.65 mm Hg, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol decreased by 0.03 mmol/L. However, diabetes screening adherence improved, with 16% more foot screenings and 6% more eye screenings compared with control patients. Health care utilization shifted toward primary care, with decreased inpatient hospitalizations (SGD $2,432 savings per person), decreased specialist outpatient visits (SGD $130 savings per person), fewer emergency department visits (SGD $49 savings per person), but increased polyclinic utilization cost (SGD $479 per person). Overall cost savings totaled SGD $2,186 per patient.
abstract.textZh: Teamlet模型實現了適度的臨牀改善；糖化血紅蛋白(Glycated hemoglobin)在HbA1c未增加的次組中減少了0.1% ，收縮壓(systolic blood pressure)減少了0.65 mm Hg ，低密度脂蛋白膽固醇(low-density lipoprotein cholesterol)減少了0.03 mmol/L。然而，糖尿病篩查依從性有所改善，與對照患者相比，足部篩查增加了16% ，眼睛篩查增加了6%。醫療保健使用轉向初級保健，住院病人住院費用減少（每人節省$ 2,432新元） ，專科門診就診人數減少（每人節省$ 130新元） ，急診部門就診人數減少（每人節省$ 49新元） ，但複合診所使用成本增加（每人$ 479新元）。每位患者總共節省了2,186新元$。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Restructuring polyclinic workforces into smaller collaborative teams improved care processes and decreased high-cost health care utilization. These findings suggest that scaling team-based care models in high-volume primary care settings might improve overall health care system efficiency and costs.Abstracts available in: يبرع (Arabic), (Chinese), Francais (French), Deutsch (German),हिन्दी (Hindi), Indonesian (Indonesian), (Japanese), Portugues (Portuguese), and Español (Spanish).

articles.title: AI-Enhanced Super-Resolution Handheld Ultrasound for Carotid Plaque Detection in Community Screening
articles.authors: Lan J, Liu S, Chen H, Zhang T, Zeng P, Li J, Jin L, Tan T, et al.

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of disability and death, and early identification of carotid atherosclerotic plaques is critical for stroke prevention in primary care and community settings. We examined whether artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced handheld ultrasound (HHUS) could improve carotid plaque detection and stenosis assessment in community-based primary care screening.
abstract.textZh: 缺血性中風是殘疾和死亡的主要原因，早期識別頸動脈粥樣硬化斑塊對於初級保健和社區環境中的中風預防至關重要。我們研究了人工智能（ AI ）增強型手持超聲波（ HHUS ）是否可以改善基於社區的初級保健篩查中的頸動脈斑塊檢測和狹窄評估。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We developed a super-resolution reconstruction model (Hyper-CycleGAN) and validated it in a clinical cohort of 127 patients with 198 plaques. The validated model was then applied in a community screening setting with 117 participants and 153 plaques, using portable ultrasound as the reference standard. We evaluated agreement with the reference standard (Bland-Altman, intraclass correlation coefficient) and community diagnostic performance (detection rates, quadratic-weighted Cohen κ, confusion matrices, and standard metrics).
abstract.textZh: 我們開發了一個超分辨率重建模型（ Hyper-CycleGAN ） ，並在127名患者與198個斑塊的臨牀隊列中進行了驗證。然後使用便攜式超聲波作為參考標準，將經過驗證的模型應用於有117名參與者和153個斑塊的社區篩選環境中。我們評估了與參考標準(Bland-Altman ，類內相關係數)和社區診斷績效(檢測率、二次加權Cohen κ、混淆矩陣和標準指標)的一致性。

articles.authors: Ferrin AA, Khudaier SE, Martinez J, Matz C, Cui S, Jabbarpour Y, Fortuna KL

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: In 2024, Medicare introduced principal illness navigation peer support (PIN-PS) reimbursement codes, creating the first nationwide reimbursement mechanism specifically for peer-delivered support services under Medicare. Little is known about early implementation of these codes. This study identified barriers and facilitators to PIN-PS adoption across clinical, organizational, and policy settings.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted semi-structured, qualitative interviews with 20 participants representing physicians, certified peer support specialists and leaders, policy professionals, payer representatives, and behavioral health or recovery organizational leaders. Interviews were analyzed using the Rigorous and Accelerated Data Reduction technique and guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research.
abstract.textZh: 我們對代表醫生、認證同儕支援專家和領導者、政策專業人士、付款人代表以及行為健康或恢復組織領導者的20名參與者進行了半結構化的定性訪談。採訪使用嚴格和加速數據減少技術進行分析，並在實施研究綜合框架的指導下進行。

articles.title: Social Support in Group Medical Visits for Chronic Pain in Primary Care
articles.authors: Ko HJ, Jackson JLN, Thompson-Lastad A, Wennik J, Swedlow P, Chao MT

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Social support is associated with improved outcomes for people with chronic pain and is an important but understudied component of biopsychosocial pain care. We sought to explore how group medical visits facilitate 4 distinct types of social support-emotional, appraisal, informational, and instrumental-among primary care patients with chronic pain.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We collected qualitative data within a randomized trial of integrative group medical visits for chronic pain, focusing on 2 cohorts of English-speaking patients randomized to group medical visits. Data came from 16 observed group medical visits, 2 focus groups, and 12 semistructured interviews. The group medical visit intervention entailed 12 weekly sessions combining clinical care, pain education, mindfulness meditation, therapeutic movement, and facilitated discussion. We analyzed data using team-based flexible coding and codebook thematic analysis.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The 26 participating patients were predominantly low-income (80.8% had an annual household income of less than $50,000); 50.0% identified as Black or African American, 15.4% as Hispanic or Latine, and 23.1% as White. On average, they had severe pain with a mean intensity rating of 7.7 out of 10. All 4 social support types emerged through structured program components (curriculum, facilitation strategies, program structure) and interactions among peers and facilitators. Emotional support fostered belonging and countered isolation and stigma. Appraisal support normalized struggles and fostered self-compassion. Informational support combined interactive education with peer-to-peer knowledge exchange. Instrumental support provided concrete assistance.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Our findings illustrate how group medical visits for chronic pain mobilize 4 interwoven and reinforcing forms of social support as core therapeutic processes. They also highlight group medical visits as a potential model for biopsychosocial chronic pain management among primary care patients.

articles.title: Influence of Physician Behaviors on How Patients Interpret Normal Test Results
articles.authors: Kube T, Seewald A

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Reassuring patients that nothing serious is wrong is one of the most common interventions in family medicine. However, medical reassurance can sometimes fail, and it is not yet clear what role the doctor's behavior plays in this regard. We tested the preregistered hypothesis that a doctor's warmth and competence significantly and independently influence patients' responses to normal results from diagnostic testing.
abstract.textZh: 向患者保證沒有任何嚴重問題是家庭醫學中最常見的幹預措施之一。然而，醫療保證有時會失敗，目前還不清楚醫生的行為在這方面扮演什麼角色。我們測試了預先註冊的假設，即醫生的溫暖和能力顯著且獨立地影響患者對診斷測試正常結果的反應。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We used an online convenience sample reporting medium somatic symptom burden (N = 349, mean age 29.9 years, 79% female) and completed an experimental analog study. After presentation of a symptom vignette, participants watched a videotaped medical report in which a doctor provided the results of diagnostic tests, stating that no abnormality had been identified. Whereas the diagnostic information was always the same, the doctor's behavior differed in terms of warmth (high vs low) and competence (high vs low).
abstract.textZh: 我們使用在線便利樣本報告中等軀體症狀負擔（ N = 349 ，平均年齡29.9歲， 79 ％為女性） ，並完成了一項實驗類比研究。在呈現症狀暈影後，參與者觀看了一份醫療報告錄像，其中醫生提供了診斷測試的結果，指出沒有發現異常。儘管診斷資訊始終相同，但醫生的行為在溫暖（高與低）和能力（高與低）方面有所不同。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants rated the likelihood of a serious disease significantly lower if the doctor showed high warmth and high competence. Further results showed that high warmth and competence also led to improvements in other outcomes, such as a lower desire to seek another doctor's opinion or additional tests. A mediation analysis indicated that the effects of warmth and competence were modulated by the extent to which participants cognitively (de)valued diagnostic information.
abstract.textZh: 如果醫生表現出高熱情和高能力，參與者對嚴重疾病的可能性評分顯著降低。進一步的結果表明，高熱情和能力也導致其他結果的改善，例如尋求另一位醫生的意見或額外測試的慾望降低。調解分析表明，溫暖和能力的影響受到參與者認知（去）價值診斷信息的程度的調節。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: For patients, diagnostic information does not speak for itself; the doctor's behavior critically determines how they integrate such information. Showing high warmth and competence can help patients put trust in them and update their illness beliefs accordingly.
abstract.textZh: 對於患者來說，診斷資訊並不能說明一切；醫生的行為關鍵決定了他們如何整合這些資訊。展現高度的熱情和能力可以幫助患者信任他們，並相應地更新他們的疾病信念。

articles.title: Clinical empathy and relational continuity mitigate care fragmentation for patients with multiple long-term conditions: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Arakelyan S, Guthrie B, Anand A, Lone N, Mercer SW, Tooman T

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Services for patients with multiple long-term conditions (MLTC) operate within fragmented and poorly coordinated systems but how care experiences, perceptions, and behaviours emerge and adapt in response to service changes and increasing system complexity is poorly understood.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore how experiences and perceptions of care for patients with MLTC and their carers emerge and evolve within a complex adaptive care system to identify opportunities for better care.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative analysis of six focus groups with 28 patients with MLTC and carers in four Scottish integrated health and social care partnerships was undertaken.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data were collected between February and May 2024. Abductive analysis informed by a complex adaptive systems lens was used.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Care for patients with MLTC emerged through dynamic, reciprocal interactions between patients, carers, professionals, and organisational structures. Service changes introduced to manage rising demand were often perceived as misaligned with patients' complex needs, prompting patients and carers to modify their behaviours to navigate access barriers. Care experiences were unpredictable, shaped by reinforcing feedback loops in which small personal interactions had a disproportionate effect on trust and engagement. Informal care expanded to fill system gaps, with family members assuming coordination and advocacy roles. Clinical empathy and relational continuity of care acted as key stabilising influences within fragmented care systems.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Service changes intended to improve care efficiency can inadvertently destabilise care and shift the burden onto patients with MLTC and their carers, affecting perceived care quality and relational continuity. The quality of interactions and relationships between agents shape patients' perceptions of care and future engagement.

articles.title: Cost savings from primary care clinic continuity among patients with chronic disease in Alberta, Canada: a retrospective population-level cross-sectional study
articles.authors: McDonald T, Lethebe BC, Green LA

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Continuity of care with a primary care physician (PCP) is well known to improve patient health, result in less health service utilisation (HSU), and lower costs. Less is known about the impact of clinic continuity related to team-based care and shared practice models. Information on the cost impact of such models is needed to guide design and payment policies.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To estimate savings in HSU costs for patients with chronic disease when they are moved from primary care clinics with low and moderate continuity levels to those with high levels.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A 3-year retrospective population based cross-sectional study examined the HSU costs associated with three levels of primary care clinic continuity for approximately 70 000 matched patients from a cohort of 500 000 patients with chronic disease in Alberta, Canada. All fee-for-service PCPs were included.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Clinic continuity was calculated by adapting the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index. Costs were estimated using costing methodologies from the Canadian Institute of Health Information.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The association between continuity and acute care costs suggests achieving high clinic continuity (UPC 80-100%) for all 195 000 patients in less than high clinic continuity care could theoretically yield upwards of £898 million over 3 years. Estimated per-patient gains were highest among the most medically complex patients.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Cost savings were associated with clinic continuity among patients with common chronic diseases at all levels of complexity. Significant cost savings could be realised by focusing patient care on primary care clinics that favour high levels of continuity.

articles.title: Moving on from patient safety incidents: a qualitative study exploring GP perspectives in England
articles.authors: Tawse J, Armitage CJ, Chew-Graham CA, Panagioti M

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Patient safety incidents (PSIs), defined as unintended or unexpected events that could have or did lead to patient harm, can have profound effects on GPs. Understanding how GPs experience and recover from PSIs is important for workforce wellbeing and patient safety in primary care.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore how GPs experience PSIs, how they move on, and how they use available support.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative study with GPs in England.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Semi-structured interviews were conducted with 22 GPs. Data were analysed using thematic analysis. Participants were eligible if they had been involved in a PSI in general practice, spanning near misses to events resulting in patient harm. Themes were developed inductively and mapped onto the theoretical domains framework to identify cognitive, social, and environmental influences on learning, help seeking, and recovery.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Three themes were generated: personal and professional consequences; recovery and learning processes; and barriers to healing. GPs described emotional responses, including guilt, self-doubt, and fear of reputational or regulatory consequences. Peer support was valued, but access to structured support was limited. Formal investigations were experienced as distressing and compounded the emotional impact. Recovery and learning were facilitated by empathetic, systems-focused cultures, protected time for reflection, and structured opportunities to learn from incidents.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: GPs rely on informal and self-directed strategies to recover from PSIs, with variable access to formal support. Recovery is shaped by individual and organisational factors. Findings highlight the importance of compassionate, non-punitive support systems and psychologically safe environments to enable recovery and promote learning.

articles.title: Primary care practitioners' experiences managing urinary tract infections: a qualitative evidence synthesis
articles.authors: Kleuser H, Toye F, Kannapin F, Ghirotto L, Parisi S, Serafini A, Bassi MC, Gágyor I, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are common in primary care. Qualitative studies suggest that the way primary care practitioners (PCPs) manage UTIs may be influenced by a complex interplay of factors.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore the views, perceptions, and experiences of PCPs in the management of UTIs.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative evidence synthesis of studies set in general practice internationally.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Four databases were systematically searched from inception to 28 June 2024, and forward citation searching of included studies was undertaken. Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis was used to synthesise findings and the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP) checklist was applied to assess the quality of studies.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In total, 3956 records were identified and 190 publications reviewed in full. Thirty-two qualitative studies reporting on 677 PCPs were included, generating the following themes: 1) I am confident; 2) … until patient X presents; 3) I am a victim of an overstretched healthcare system; 4) I must weigh up the benefits and impact of antibiotic treatment; and 5) it all comes down to our relationship. Using the CASP checklist, the quality of research was rated as high.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: PCPs felt confident in managing UTIs, but uncertainty arose when patient X (children, men, older patients, those with recurrent UTIs) presented and PCPs perceived consultations as more complex. This analysis highlights the persistent and complex clinical challenge of assessing the risks and benefits of prescribing antibiotics. Chronic underfunding, staff shortages, and conflicting provider-patient expectations further complicated care, particularly when patients fall outside the ordinary (patient X).

articles.title: Sustaining named GP continuity requires organisational change: a comparative implementation analysis in Finland
articles.authors: Tuompo W, Mäkelä J, Timonen M, Auvinen J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maintaining doctor-patient relationship continuity remains a challenge in public primary care in Finland and internationally owing to GP workforce pressures and organisational constraints.
abstract.textZh: 由於全科醫生的勞動力壓力和組織限制，維持醫患關係的連續性仍然是芬蘭和國際公共初級保健的挑戰。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate implementation of a named GP model and explain differences in implementation outcomes between two Finnish primary care units.
abstract.textZh: 評估指定的全科醫生模式的實施情況，並解釋芬蘭兩個初級保健單位之間實施結果的差異。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A quasi-experimental before-after study was conducted in two Finnish primary care units with contrasting organisational settings. Patients were assigned a named GP responsible for non-urgent care. Electronic health record data covering physician consultations over 48 months were analysed.
abstract.textZh: 在兩個芬蘭初級保健單位中進行了準實驗性事前事後研究，組織環境形成對比。患者被指派負責非緊急護理的指定全科醫生。分析了涵蓋48個月內醫師會診的電子健康記錄數據。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Continuity was measured using the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index, the St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC), and the Own Patient Ratio (OPR). Implementation outcomes were interpreted using the RE-AIM framework. A segmented interrupted time series model was applied to OPR and SLICC, and UPC analysed using a pre-post design.
abstract.textZh: 使用普通護理提供者（ UPC ）指數、聖倫納德護理持續性指數（ SLICC ）和自身患者比率（ OPR ）來測量連續性。實施結果使用RE-AIM框架來解釋。將分段中斷時間序列模型應用於OPR和SLICC ，並使用前後設計分析UPC。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Named GP continuity was higher in Tuira than in Pudasjärvi across all measures. In Tuira, adoption (OPR 0.88) was high and stable with lower named GP-level variation, while reach (SLICC 0.31) and effectiveness (UPC 0.35) improved but remained modest. Although continuity improved in Pudasjärvi, adoption remained weaker (OPR 0.40), reach lower (SLICC 0.16), and maintenance less stable. Continuity of care with physicians other than the named GP increased more in Pudasjärvi.
abstract.textZh: 在所有措施中， Tuira的命名GP連續性都高於Pudasjärvi。在圖伊拉，採用率（ OPR 0.88 ）高且穩定， GP水平變化較低，而REACH （ SLICC 0.31 ）和有效性（ UPC 0.35 ）有所改善，但仍然適度。雖然Pudasjärvi的連續性有所改善，但採用率仍然較弱（ OPR 0.40 ） ，達到較低（ SLICC 0.16 ） ，維護不太穩定。在Pudasjärvi ，除了指定的全科醫生之外，其他醫生的持續護理增加更多。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The named GP model was functionally adopted in Tuira but remained largely nominal in Pudasjärvi. Health systems implementing named GP models should prioritise sustained GP presence and organisational alignment to achieve continuity.

articles.title: Evaluation and Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease: Synopsis of the Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline
articles.authors: Hedayati SS, Babitt JL, Berns JS, Bozkurt B, Cheung RS, Cuevas Y, Effa EE, Eisenga MF, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: The Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) provides an update of the 2012 version. Its scope includes anemia diagnosis and use of iron therapy, erythropoiesis-stimulating agents (ESAs), hypoxia-inducible factor-prolyl hydroxylase inhibitors (HIF-PHIs), and red blood cell (RBC) transfusions to treat anemia in CKD.
abstract.textZh: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)提供了2012年版本的更新。其範圍包括貧血診斷和使用鐵療法、紅細胞生成刺激劑（ ESA ）、低氧誘導因子-脯氨酰羥化酶抑制劑（ HIF-PHI ）和紅細胞（ RBC ）輸血來治療CKD中的貧血。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: An international work group of patient partners, health care professionals, researchers, and clinicians defined the guideline scope. An independent evidence review team conducted systematic reviews through October 2024 and graded the certainty of evidence using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) approach. The final guideline incorporated feedback from a public review involving registered stakeholders in late 2024.
abstract.textZh: 由患者合作夥伴、醫療保健專業人員、研究人員和臨牀醫生組成的國際工作小組確定了指南範圍。獨立證據審查團隊在2024年10月前進行了系統審查，並使用GRADE （建議評估、發展和評估的評分）方法對證據的確定性進行了評分。最終準則納入了2024年底由註冊利益相關者參與的公開評價意見。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: This synopsis focuses on the 8 graded recommendations. Key points include the use of transferrin saturation and ferritin thresholds to guide iron therapy, with intravenous iron preferred over oral iron in people receiving hemodialysis; addressing correctable causes of anemia before use of an ESA or a HIF-PHI; using an ESA rather than a HIF-PHI as first-line treatment; individualized hemoglobin (Hb) thresholds for ESA initiation based on patient characteristics, symptoms, and values; and an upper Hb target of below 11.5 g/dL (<115 g/L) during ESA maintenance therapy. The guideline also includes 49 practice points representing expert consensus where robust evidence was limited or systematic review could not be conducted.
abstract.textZh: 本大綱重點介紹8項評分建議。關鍵點包括使用轉鐵蛋白飽和度和鐵蛋白閾值來指導鐵療法，在接受血液透析的人羣中，靜脈注射鐵優於口服鐵；在使用ESA或HIF-PHI之前解決貧血的可糾正原因；使用ESA而不是HIF-PHI作為一線治療；根據患者特徵、症狀和值， ESA啟動的個性化血紅蛋白(Hb)閾值；以及在ESA維持治療期間，血紅蛋白上限目標低於11.5 g/dL (< 115 g/L)。該指南還包括代表專家共識的49個實踐點，其中有力的證據有限或無法進行系統審查。
